tools.name: explain_stitch
tools.description: Explains a stitch or technique in plain words (e.g. 'magic ring', 'single crochet', 'invisible decrease', 'French knot', 'cast on') and links to Craftuary's free lesson or guide with a 3D step-by-step diagram.

tools.name: craft_calculator
tools.description: Works out stitches, starting chain, rows and yarn for a crochet or knit blanket or scarf, the C2C grid for a size, or how to increase or decrease evenly from one stitch count to another. Same maths as Craftuary's free calculators.
